selection: Use 30 RealSR V scenes (mixed prior exposure; all 60 V already exposed in V1.5); lock before new confirm. Select global strengths by minimum LPIPS subject to camera-wise PSNR >= balanced V1.5 -0.03 dB, LPIPS <= balanced V1.5 and texture error <= balanced V1.5. Zero intervention available.
test: RealSR E and DRealSR E (previously exposed), further unseen by new model: deterministic 12+12 leftover RealSR T and 24 DRealSR T distinct from A7 transfer set; seed 29. No trained DRealSR data.
controls: Same-seed stage ablation: reuse same registered head with local alignment on/off, transfer only, self only, both and neither. Independently trained unregistered head. Cross-scale: LR-only network, LR patch-search memory, DINO re-ranked memory, misplaced DINO, wrong retrieved values, and zero memory. Evaluate alternatives on same inputs.
